description: Turn a raw product, app, bot or feature idea (even 2–3 lines) into ONE self-sufficient, evidence-backed build blueprint (.md, often 100 pages) that Claude Code or Codex executes one epic per fresh session without guessing. Runs intake, deep web research and competitor benchmarking; decides ranked architecture drivers, style and module boundaries; locks a verified, version-pinned stack; specifies the quality gate, review checklist and metrics. Writes personas, flows, design direction, UX copy tables (Persian/RTL-aware for Iranian users), edge cases, and epics → stories → Given/When/Then acceptance criteria → tests → Definition of Done, plus a plan→build→hand-off session protocol. Use whenever someone shares an idea and wants a PRD, spec, backlog, epics, user stories, roadmap, MVP plan, market research, an architecture or stack recommendation, code-quality standards, or a plan for Claude Code/Codex, even without saying 'PRD'. Prefer it over lighter PRD skills when rigor matters.
